key_insight: ThermLeT predicts steady-state temperatures in 2.5D chiplet packages in 13 ms, about four orders of magnitude faster than conventional FEM solvers such as ANSYS.
engineering_relevance: Fast thermal predictions can accelerate chiplet floorplan exploration and help engineers screen packaging designs for thermal risks.
method: Multimodal transformer integrates power density maps, spatial coordinates, material properties, and heat transfer rate.
Scale-invariant surrogate learns from 6,221 layouts perturbed from three representative architectures.
Predicts steady-state temperature fields without running a full FEM solve at inference.
evidence_signal: On 150 test samples, ThermLeT achieved 3.16°C RMSE and 2.24°C MAE, with reported accuracy improvements of 35% over ThermEDGe and 71% over HotSpot.
watch_item: Training layouts originate from only three architectures; performance on substantially different packages and operating conditions needs independent validation.
paper_title: ThermLeT: Transformer-based Temperature Prediction for 2.5D Chiplet Architecture
